title: L-fuzzy simplicial homology
summary: Simplicial homology is a classical tool that assigns a sequence of modules to a simplicial complex, providing invariants for the study of its topological properties. In this article, we introduce the notion of L-fuzzy simplicial homology, a generalization of simplicial homology for L-fuzzy subcomplexes, in which each simplex is assigned a value from a completely distributive lattice L. We present its definition and main properties and describe methods to compute its structure.
